summary: Frontend-only smoke/e2e test of OfficeFlow preview (https://officeflow-v11.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified login page render, super_admin cookie login -> /dashboard, workspace chooser modal, dashboard render (no infinite loading), sidebar navigation (Employees, Work Shifts, Payroll), direct URL navigation to Employees/Dispatch Dashboard/Dispatch Schedules/Attendance/Clients/Settings, portal switch (Employee <-> Dispatch), auth persistence on hard refresh, logout and post-logout route guard. All requested flows PASSED. No application code changed.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection to wss://<preview>/api/ws/dispatch fails ('closed before the connection is established') on dashboard/dispatch pages. Non-blocking (pages poll/refresh every 10s and render fine), but live push updates are inactive on the preview ingress.

issues: Header cell text wraps awkwardly ('DUTY HOUR S'); rightmost column 'SHIFT...' is clipped at 1920px width

action_items: Optional: confirm whether /api/ws/dispatch WebSocket is expected to work through the preview ingress; if not supported, suppress the console warning / rely on polling fallback (currently already falls back gracefully).
Optional cosmetic: fix Dispatch Schedule table header wrapping/last-column clipping.
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows two 401s from GET /api/auth/me on the unauthenticated /login load (expected by design, but noisy in logs).
Stale backup files present in /app/frontend/src/components (ProtectedRoute.js.backup-*, ClientProtectedRoute.js.blink-backup) - dead files, safe to remove.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); login/me verified via curl 200

seed_data_creation: None. DB left empty apart from auto-seeded super_admin (admin@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is functional end-to-end for admin auth + navigation. Useful testids: login-email-input, login-password-input, portal-select-employee/dispatch, nav-<page-name>, switch-portal-button, user-menu-trigger, logout-button, active-portal-label. Note the workspace-chooser modal (portal-select-overlay) appears right after login and must be dismissed before interacting with the dashboard. All list pages show empty states (no seed data). Client Portal (/client-portal/login) not tested.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no failures. Earlier test-script failures were selector issues (get_by_role('link') / 'header button') resolved by using data-testid selectors.
